project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 7 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 15 of 15 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Scalford qualifies as a local detour through Churchyard cross in St Egelwin's churchyard and CHURCH OF ST EGELWIN THE MARTYR. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Scalford: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Scalford offers Churchyard cross in St Egelwin's churchyard, CHURCH OF ST EGELWIN THE MARTYR, BASE OF MEDIEVAL CROSS TO SOUTH OF PARISH CHURCH OF ST EGELWIN THE MARTYR within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
